t.description: Starting point is directly behind the highway sign. Check out this 3.9-km out-and-back trail near Port Hardy, British Columbia. A moderately challenging route with some ropes. This is a popular trail for hiking and running. The trail is open year-round.
t.name: Dakota 576 Crash Site Trail Access
t.note: PARKING; Park across the street at the marina or along the roadway.
